name: causoryn
description: Deterministic, local, LLM-free code analysis for ZCode: read-only workspace graphs, architecture mapping, symbol search and evidence provenance over a stdio MCP server.

description_i18n.en: Deterministic, local, LLM-free code analysis for ZCode: read-only workspace graphs, architecture mapping, symbol search and evidence provenance over a stdio MCP server.

config_json.title: Causoryn server config (JSON)
config_json.description: JSON handed to the local Causoryn server as the CAUSORYN_CONFIG environment variable. Declare authorized workspace roots via allowRoots (read-only analysis; the manifest itself carries no sensitive values). Example: {"allowRoots":["C:/projects/my-app"]}. The default denies all roots; workspace tools then answer WORKSPACE_NOT_AUTHORIZED until a root is authorized here.
